context.molt_result_note: Molt complete. Recovery checklist: (1) Read your pad (system prompt) — find current task and next step. (2) Re-read your summary in this tool call args — past-you wrote it for you. (3) Check your inbox and communication channels for messages received during molt. (4) Confirm task matches pad, then continue. Four durable stores survived intact. Do not repeat kept entries.
system_tool.sleep_message: Going to sleep. Your identity, pad, and chat history are preserved. Any incoming inbox message (mail, system notification, peer message) will wake you.
system_tool.sleep_refused_pending_notifi: Sleep refused — a notification arrived during this turn and has not been processed yet. Staying ACTIVE; the pending notification will surface on the next IDLE boundary. Pass force=true to sleep anyway.
system_tool.refresh_message: Refresh initiated — you will be suspended and relaunched momentarily. Do not make any more tool calls.
context.context_forget_summary: [system] Molt complete. Working memory is empty. Recent conversation entries were preserved in your context — read them to re-orient. If you need more prior context, check logs/events.jsonl — the file is large, so grep/tail/filter rather than dumping it whole.
context.context_forget_summary_aed: [system] Context cleared after {attempts} consecutive LLM failures. Working memory is empty. Recent conversation entries were preserved in your context — read them to re-orient. Also check system/pad.md for your working notes, check knowledge entries via the knowledge catalog, then check your inbox for current tasks. Continue from there.
context.context_forget_summary_signal: [system] Context cleared by {source}. Working memory is empty. Recent conversation entries were preserved in your context — read them to re-orient. Also check system/pad.md for your working notes, check knowledge entries via the knowledge catalog, then check your inbox for current tasks. Continue from there.
email.contact_address: The contact's address (working directory path). Optional.
knowledge.preamble: The following knowledge entries are your private durable memory across molts. When you need to recall what you previously learned, decided, or discovered, use shell to load the KNOWLEDGE.md file at the path shown in that entry's location field, then follow what it says. Each entry folder may carry supporting files (scripts, assets, raw logs) — the KNOWLEDGE.md will reference them. Entries you want at hand can be referenced from system/pad.md, which you edit through shell and apply with context.rebuild. Knowledge is private to you; if no entry applies, do not load any.
avatar.parent_prompt: [system] You are an avatar of {parent_name}, whose address is {parent_address}. Please keep this in your psyche memory so you remember who spawned you. When you complete your mission, encounter problems you cannot resolve, or need to report back, email your parent at the address above.
skills.preamble: The following skills provide specialized instructions for specific tasks. When a task matches a skill's description, use shell to load the SKILL.md file at the path shown in that skill's location field, then follow its instructions. Each skill folder may contain supporting files (scripts, templates, data) — the SKILL.md will reference them. Skills you use often can be referenced from system/pad.md, which you edit through shell and apply with context.rebuild. If no skill clearly applies, do not load any.
